items.quote: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made
items.claim: The wise men who had worked on the sanctuary came from their work

items.quote: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
items.claim: The people brought more material than sufficient for the sanctuary work
